Chethana Assistant ProfessorB.Sc (Electronics, University of Mysore), MCA (IGNOU), Ph.D. (Jain University) Linkedin Link Dr. S. Chethana is a competent professional with over 22 years of experience in teaching Computer Science. She is a student-centred educator with public and private teaching experience spanning inclusive classrooms and one-on-one settings. Creative and resourceful, she adapts instructional strategies to meet unique student needs. Recognised for her teaching excellence and enthusiastic instruction, she demonstrates an “above-and-beyond” commitment to maximising learning outcomes and student success. She has published 11 patents, including one Australian patent, and four publications, two of which are in SCI Journal.
